thesis: The page is a topographic survey sheet: every section sits at an elevation band marked by contour lines, and the site climbs from valley floor to ridge as you scroll, proving this company reads the ground before it pours.

signature.name: Contour Line + Elevation Marker
signature.summary: Soft terracotta contour SVG pattern behind every section; elevation-marker trail-sign pill on each header; corner elevation counter climbs via --sw-p; benchmark triangle on every photo caption; town-pin mini-map in proof.

motion.intro: Contour lines draw via stroke-dashoffset staggered 60ms; town pins drop; headline fades up. Skippable, ≤1.2s.
stories: freeze-thaw 4-step diagram pinned to frosted-slab photo
base-layer cross-section builds subgrade→base→steel→slab as elevation climbs
motion.hover: Hairline rule grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms, consistent
